title: Exact outcome-aware planning is proved for two observations
statement: The acquired independent derivation accepts A_i=c_i^2 V_i(1)+(1-m_i)T_i^0+m_i T_i^1, maximizing over first source i. Each T_i^x is the exact best repeat-i or ancestor-sibling continuation after x; disjoint subtrees retain their own one-step values, and multiaffine mean/derivative changes propagate exactly without division by zero sensitivities. A top-down outside-derivative pass plus both outcomes/all ancestor siblings costs O(N+nkh), O(N) extra storage. The exact policy attains the two-observation adaptive optimum, while outward intervals certify an achieved lower and optimal upper gain. An ordinary baseline GIVEN the new P1 one-step compiler can hypothetically update/undo each first observation and tie O(nh); no asymptotic or timing advantage is accepted. Reported independent audit enumerates993 policies/3972 outcome pairs at24 states and includes interval invariants. No optimal3-step/general-horizon or cheap maintained global first-action theorem follows. Comparator correction: the ordinary adaptive method is AUGMENTED WITH P1'S NEW one-step compiler and reversible hypothetical updates. Its O(nh) tie isolates the adaptive SEARCH layer. It is not an independently pre-existing incumbent and does NOT establish that the new representation/fixed-batch optimizer is already known, valueless or non-novel. Novelty and practical advantage remain unestablished in either direction; no new literature audit is imposed. The ordinary decision-only135 versus4233 full-cache acquisition fixture remains genuine and separately scoped.

Arithmetic bounds count total nodes N,leaf count n,height h,actual arity k and explicit gate-table/derivative construction. Unary chains,deep trees,dense edits,exact bit growth and observation/maintenance data are paid.

Adaptive two-step query costs O(N+sum_i sum_(ancestors v)arity(v)), bounded by O(N+nkh), extra O(N) storage. Equally informed ordinary one-step compiler+hypothetical update/undo matches O(nh), with no new physical draws for hypothetical outcomes.

Synthetic depth8 workload uses65536 sources,21845 gates,65536 charged initial+2000 later observations,1000 fixed pairs and19 local target edits; build13.9003s,online5.2606s,16152 online gates,226128 candidate evaluations,258432 derivative entries. Changed targets prevent summing gains as one telescoping risk drop.

At the same final learner state, reconstruction costs11.3698s and adaptive query45.1596s for65536 first actions/3276800 conditional groups. Its gain is about2.84% above fixed-pair gain (not2.84% of total residual risk), with no new source calls; no total practical-efficiency win.
